## Summary

Describe the research problem addressed and the user-visible change.

## Validation

- [ ] Native checks pass with `swift run ResearchAtlasChecks` using the documented test command.
- [ ] Desktop checks pass with `npm run check` and `npm test` in `Desktop/`.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behaviour or setup changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private research material, local paths, generated packages, or database files are included.

## Research integrity and privacy

- [ ] Provenance, verification state, and uncertainty remain visible where relevant.
- [ ] The change does not make an external AI provider mandatory.
- [ ] Any external transmission is explicit, previewable, and user-approved.

## Screenshots or notes

Add sanitised screenshots or implementation notes when they help reviewers. Do not include private research content.
